sourceRefs.locator: Heading, opening and dating clause: 1 March 752, Verberie, rex Francorum. Narrative: Loba’s testament, Gislemar’s admission and surrender per festucam, Fulrad, and the preceding hearing before King Chilperic.
Q815701, coordinate location (P625), rounded to two decimal places.

processingNote.de: Der Ausstellungsort der Urkunde ist Verberie. Die Umrisslinie dient der Orientierung in der Umgebung der heutigen Stadt.
processingNote.en: The charter names Verberie as its place of issue. The outline provides orientation around the present town.

rights.originNote: Original editorial outline around the open reference coordinate. Its edges have no archaeological or political significance.
